fusions.name: Barbed Postscript
fusions.desc: Flicks a barbed slip into the first enemy it meets for 3 damage, leaving the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarm Circular
fusions.desc: Sends a circular through the swarm, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your afflictions on each enemy hit are copied to every other enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Piecework
fusions.desc: Your attack speed rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Tireless Scriveners
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 mana a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
